instruction: 請你針對以下敘述，評量你同意每個敘述的程度。
instruction_en: Below are five statements that you may agree or disagree with. Using the 1-7 scale below, indicate your agreement with each item.

text: 大致上我目前的生活跟我理想的生活狀態相當接近。
text_en: In most ways my life is close to my ideal.

text: 我的生活狀態非常理想。
text_en: The conditions of my life are excellent.
I am satisfied with my life.

text: 到目前為止，我能夠在生活中獲得我所想要的事物。
text_en: So far I have gotten the important things I want in life.

text: 如果生活可以重頭來過，我不會做大幅度的改變。
text_en: If I could live my life over, I would change almost nothing.
